name: Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy

criteria.description: Presence of early joint contractures, especially of the elbows, Achilles tendons, and neck
Progressive muscle weakness and wasting predominantly affecting humeroperoneal muscles
Cardiac conduction abnormalities including atrioventricular block and arrhythmias
Positive family history consistent with X-linked or autosomal dominant/recessive inheritance
Identification of pathogenic variants in EMD, LMNA, or related genes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of early contractures, characteristic muscle weakness pattern, and cardiac conduction defects
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing supports diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical criteria are met.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Early joint contractures (elbows, Achilles tendons, neck)
searchTerms: early stiffening of joints like elbows and neck
tightening of tendons causing limited joint motion
weakness and muscle loss in upper arms and lower legs
muscle wasting in humerus and fibula areas
muscle weakness affecting arm and leg muscles
heart rhythm problems like block or arrhythmia
difficulty breathing due to muscle weakness

laboratory: Elevated serum creatine kinase (mild to moderate elevation)
imaging: Muscle MRI showing selective muscle atrophy and fatty infiltration
Echocardiogram may show cardiac chamber dilation or dysfunction
genetic: Pathogenic variants in EMD gene (X-linked form)
Pathogenic variants in LMNA gene (autosomal dominant/recessive forms)
other: Electrocardiogram showing conduction defects and arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly proximal muscle weakness without early contractures
Absence of early joint contractures and cardiac conduction defects

redFlags: Progressive cardiac conduction block or arrhythmias
Rapidly worsening muscle weakness with respiratory compromise
references: Emery AEH. Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy. In: GeneReviews® [Internet]. University of Washington, Seattle; 2020.
Bonne G, et al. Emery-Dreifuss Muscular Dystrophy. Lancet Neurol. 2018;17(11):1050-1060.
Mercuri E, et al. Diagnosis and management of Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy. Neuromuscul Disord. 2019;29(10):801-812.
